6. Leave Automatic recovery and Resume after reboot enabled if desired. In Background reliability, optionally allow background usage for both ClipHistory and Shizuku.

7. After every reboot, unlock the phone and start Shizuku again. ClipHistory reconnects when recovery is permitted. If recording remains stopped, open ClipHistory and tap Connect. Copies made before recording resumes cannot be recovered.
